issue_context.title: MiAir Purifier Pro H hourly unavailable after 2021.9.4
issue_context.body: ### The problem Hi and thanks for this integration. There is an error that makes HA see the MiAir PRO H as unavailable for 1min and a few seconds. If you have a notification to alert you when the device is ON (or off) you basically get hourly push notifications :( _Logger: homeassistant.components.xiaomi_miio Source: helpers/update_coordinator.py:219 Integration: Xiaomi Miio (documentation, issues) First occurred: 12:00:22 AM (2 occurrences) Last logged: 12:52:52 AM **Error** fetching Mi Air Purifier Pro H data: {'code': -9999, 'message': 'user ack timeout'}_ I tried going back to 2021.9.**5** -> does not fix the issue. I tried going back to 2021.9.**4** -> FIXED - the error still appears in the logs, but somehow, does not make the device 'unavailable'. I was using latest version (core 2021.9.6) on a Synology NAS as a docker container. For the integration I have "zhimi.airpurifier.mb3". System is clean, nothing else configured/installed because I wanted to just get to the bottom of this issue. If you are kind and have the time, maybe you can take a look ? Thank you. ### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue? core-2021.9.6 ### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core? core-2021.9.4 ### What type of installation are you running? Home Assistant Container ### Integration causing the issue Xiaomi Mi Air PRO H ### Link to integration documentation on our website _No response_ ### Example YAML snippet _No response_ ### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us? ```txt 2021-09-13 02:58:02 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.xiaomi_miio] Error fetching Mi Air Purifier Pro H data: {'code': -9999, 'message': 'user ack timeout'} ``` ### Additional information _No response_

@rytilahti Do you think HA should try to fetch the data a second time when `{'code': -9999, 'message': 'user ack timeout}` occurs? Or maybe we can fix this in a different way?
Same fom me … but i have Xiaomi Purifier 3H

@bieniu doing a retry inside homeassistant could work as a stopgap solution, but if this is a common issue for this model, I'd like to see the retry logic directly inside python-miio.

Do you have an idea if this happens also on other devices? From what I've seen, this error has previously come up when trying to use commands not supported by the device.

review_comments:
It possibly can retry infinitely.

I think we should add a `retry=True` flag to be sure we are fetching only twice.

If the first attempt ends with an exception, we raise `UpdateFailed()` (so we end this function) or we go to the second attempt if error code is `-9999`. Under what circumstances can there be an infinite retrying?
Depends on how many times the device sends -9999. I also think it should be limited.
The device returns this error for less than 10 seconds. Integration polls the device every 60 seconds. So IMO there cannot be infinite retrying.
